previous_reply_acts.author: claude-15
previous_reply_acts.text:
(loader is ready) `minus40.sorries` turns the verdicts into futon1b records. Only verdicts with verbatim quotes are used.
- **conflict:** a sorry, written as a futon3c-shaped challenge plus a `:memory/sorry` edge.
- **restates:** a `:memory/restates` edge.
- **replaces:** a `:memory/supersede-proposed` edge from the older memory to the newer one. It isn't applied, since a model made the call.
- **Commands:** `list` shows open sorries with both quotes. `discharge <id> a|b|both|neither <note>` closes one and keeps the open period in history.
- **Challenged state:** a memory counts as `:challenged` (futon2's term) while an open sorry touches it, so no version edges get rewritten.
